what: Carrier Global makes heating, air conditioning and refrigeration equipment. It sells air conditioners and heat pumps for homes and buildings, refrigerated transport units under Carrier Transicold, and German heating systems through Viessmann.
customers: Homeowners through contractors, commercial building owners, supermarkets and food distributors, and truck and container fleets.
money: residential and commercial heating and cooling in North America
Carrier Transicold truck, trailer and container units
moat: Contractor relationships and installed equipment that is replaced with the same brand, plus distribution that reaches tens of thousands of installers.
risks: It reported a loss in the latest twelve months after charges relating to disposals
European heat pump demand fell sharply when subsidies were cut
Debt of about $12 billion remains from the Viessmann purchase
opportunities: Analysts see about 30% upside from current levels
New US refrigerant rules force equipment replacement across the installed base
Data centre cooling is a growing commercial market
watch: Americas HVAC volumes and European heat pump demand.
